review: Read-only production animation and WindowServer frame review
limitations: Fixed on-battery inputs use the neutral instrument tint; green/blue palettes and native popup composition are covered by the separate six-state capture set.
Capture frame 083 to 084 has a 0.752 second gap, followed by catch-up samples; this is capture timing evidence, not a measured production animation stall.
Frame 000 contains pre-restart compositor output; native viewing GIF uses frames 001 through 080.
Eight fps verifies the visual cycle, not display-refresh-rate smoothness.
